children: Fiserv's digital asset platform is live, processing Roughrider Coin transactions on Solana. The Bank of North Dakota's stablecoin lets more than 90 banks and credit unions move money between them in seconds. VersaBank issues the stablecoin, and Fireblocks provides tokenization.

The live service puts Solana into the settlement workflow of participating financial institutions, making institutional stablecoin use an operating deployment rather than an announced plan. For SOL, that provides a concrete basis for assessing real-world adoption through the network's role in processing transfers. The banking use case is money movement between institutions, with Solana handling transactions and separate providers responsible for issuance and tokenization.
